meta.name: boss-zhipin-scraper
meta.description: Scrape BOSS直聘 (job listing site) via Chrome CDP. Searches jobs by keyword/city/filters, fetches JD details, outputs structured JSON/CSV with plaintext salary, and can summarize scraped results into a job-market prompt. Use when user wants to search/analyze jobs on BOSS直聘 or zhipin.com.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抓取招聘网站职位,输出结构化清单与薪资汇总
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想批量收集招聘岗位并对比薪资行情
copy.tagline_en: Scrape job listings into structured data with clear salary figures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to collect job postings in bulk and compare salaries

howto.what: 你让它搜 BOSS直聘职位，它会用 Chrome 抓取职位列表和 JD 详情，输出含明文薪资的 JSON/CSV，还能把已抓取结果汇总成求职市场摘要和材料优化提示词。
howto.when: 当你想在 BOSS直聘（zhipin.com）上搜索或分析职位时触发；需要 Chrome 已安装、Python 3.10+，并已登录 zhipin.com。

howto.what_en: Point it at BOSS直聘 and it scrapes job listings through Chrome CDP: search by keyword/city/filters, fetch JD details, output JSON/CSV with plaintext salary, and summarize results into a job-market prompt.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to search or analyze jobs on BOSS直聘 (zhipin.com). Needs Chrome installed, Python 3.10+, and a logged-in zhipin.com session.
